verdict.rationale: A data-processing SaaS platform like Crossmint could reasonably publish an AI-training opt-out or a no-training data policy, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI model training or a data-use opt-out. The wallet, payment, webhook and docs-for-AI-assistants material is about other capabilities and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
